proposals.before: In year two's second month Gaozu sent chief secretary Zhao Jingyue to announce an edict accepting Lijian's surrender; Lijian bared his torso and begged pardon.
proposals.after: In year two's first month Gaozu sent chief secretary Zhao Jingyue to announce an edict accepting Lijian's surrender; Lijian bared his torso and begged pardon.
proposals.reason: Chinese 正月 is the first month, not the second.

proposals.before: Qi Lord of Anding Zijing held southern Yang and kept many troops for self-defense.

proposals.reason: 安陸王 is Prince of Anlu, not Anding; 南兗州 is Southern Yanzhou, not southern Yang.

proposals.after: When Bozhi arrived he was made bearer of staff, area commander of Western Yuzhou, Pacification North general, and Western Yuzhou inspector, Marquis of Yongxin with a fief of one thousand households.

proposals.before: The historian writes: Liu Jilian had a literary man's polish, yet could not save himself—as habit in troubled times will do.
proposals.after: The historian writes: Liu Lijian had a literary man's polish, yet could not save himself—as habit in troubled times will do.

proposals.before: The historian says: Liu Jilian had the small refinements of a literary official, yet could not preserve himself—such is growing accustomed to disorder.
proposals.after: The historian says: Liu Lijian had the small refinements of a literary official, yet could not preserve himself—such is growing accustomed to disorder.

proposals.before: At that time Shiwen'an of Kuaiji, styled Shouxiu, lived in seclusion practicing courtesy, had replaced Lijian as Left Director, gone out as Jiangxia interior governor, then replaced him again as Censor-in-Chief—and he and Lijian were friends.
proposals.after: At that time Shi Wen'an of Kuaiji, styled Shouxiu, lived in seclusion practicing courtesy, had replaced Lijian as Left Director, gone out as Jiangxia interior governor, then replaced him again as Censor-in-Chief—and he and Lijian were friends.
proposals.reason: 石文安 is the surname Shi plus given name Wen'an, not the fused Shiwen'an.

decisions.reason: s0010 南郡太守 names the commandery 南郡 (Nanjun); Nankang is 南康 and is not in the Chinese.
The literal likewise renders 南郡 as Nankang; Nanjun is the correct place name for 南郡.
s0052 元起，南郡人 states Yuanqi was a man of 南郡 (Nanjun), not Nankang.
The literal of s0052 likewise misreads 南郡 as Nankang; Nanjun restores the Chinese place name.
s0053 季連爲南郡之時 refers to Lijian’s tenure over 南郡 (Nanjun), not Nankang.
The literal of s0053 has the same 南郡→Nankang error; Nanjun matches the Chinese.
s0076 二年正月 is the first month of year two; 正月 is not the second month.
The literal likewise turns 正月 into “second month”; “first month” is required by the Chinese.
s0098 齊安陸王子敬爲南兗州 names Prince of Anlu Zijing and Southern Yanzhou; “Anding” and “southern Yang” misread 安陸王 and 南兗州.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 齊安陸王子敬爲南兗州

decisions.reason: The literal of s0098 has the same Anding/southern Yang errors; Prince of Anlu and Southern Yanzhou match 安陸王 and 南兗州.
s0203 都督西豫州諸軍事 and 西豫州刺史 name Western Yuzhou (西豫州), not Western Xinyang.
The literal likewise misreads 西豫州 as Western Xinyang; Western Yuzhou restores the Chinese province name.

decisions.reason: s0207 names 褚緭; 緭 is read Wei, and Chu Chuo invents a different reading of the same personal name.
The literal of s0207 likewise has Chu Chuo for 褚緭; Chu Wei is the correct romanization of that name.
s0211 names 劉季連, whom the chapter elsewhere consistently romanizes as Liu Lijian; Liu Jilian is an inconsistent spelling of the same person.
The literal of s0211 likewise uses Liu Jilian for 劉季連; Liu Lijian matches the chapter’s established romanization.
s0046 石文安 is surname 石 plus given name 文安 (Shi Wen'an); fusing them as Shiwen'an mis-segments the personal name.

Accepted r0013 shows English Chu Chuo came only from the bad reading of 褚緭; the personal-name claim must read Chu Wei while keeping zh, id, subject, predicate, certainty, and evidence.
